Kabhi kabhi (وَ) teen alfaaz ko jodne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai. Niche diye gaye Quranic fiqron ko padhiye jinhe aap khud samajh sakte hain.

data.text: Darj zail misaalein dekhein:

Upar zikr kiye gaye tamam Quranic alfaaz ke aakhir mein (ة/ـة) hai. Aise tamam alfaaz Arabic mein muzakkar ke muqaabile mein muannath hote hain aur in alfaaz ke liye ism-e-ishaarah (هٰذِهِ) hoga. Kuch aise alfaaz bhi hain jin ke aakhir mein (ة/ـة) nahin hai lekin Arabic mein unhe muannath maana jaata hai jaise (جَهَنَّمُ), (نَارٌ), (سَمَاءٌ), (أَرْضُ).
Ab aap darj zail jumloon ko khud samajh aur tarjuma kar sakte hain.
Door ki muannath cheez ke liye ism-e-ishaarah (تِلْكَ) hota hai. Darj zail Quranic jumloon ko khud samjho aur tarjuma karo.

(تِلْكَ) aam taur par door ki muannath cheez ke liye istemal hoti hai, lekin Quran-e-Pak mein zyada tar 'yeh' ki jagah istemal hoti hai aur isi mafhoom mein samajhna chahiye. Upar aapne 'woh' se tarjuma kiya. Ab dobara tarjuma karein aur 'yeh' istemal karein.

Agar (تِلْكَ) ya (هٰذِهِ) ke baad aane wala lafz (الـ) se shuru ho jaise (الشَّجَرَة, النَّارُ) toh jumla mukammal nahin hota, kyunki (هٰذِهِ) aur (الـ) se shuru hone wale lafz ka milap mafool (mubtada ya khabar) bana deta hai. Is liye tarjuma mein 'hai' nahin aayega.
Di gayi mithaal ko samne rakh kar ab darj zail jumloon ko khud samjho aur tarjuma karo.

data.text: Quran-e-Pak ko samajhne ke liye alfaaz, mukhtalif qism ke jumle, muhaavre aur chand zaroori qawaid jaanna zaroori hai. Is kitab mein In Sha Allah aap yeh sab cheezein aahista aahista aur aasaani ke saath seekhein ge.

data.instruction: Darj zail jumloon ka tarjuma karein:

items.hinglish: Aur beshak woh maal ki muhabbat mein yaqeenan sakht hai
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan qiyamat ki nishani hai
Beshak woh yaqeenan izzat wala Quran hai

items.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُولِي الْأَبْصَارِ
items.hinglish: Beshak is mein yaqeenan ibrat hai aankhon walon ke liye
Beshak is mein yaqeenan ek nishani hai tumhare liye
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan naseehat hai
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan naafarmani hai
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan ek kasam hai
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan ek kitaab hai
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan naseehat hai parhezgaron ke liye

data.instruction: Darj zail jumloon ka tarjuma karein:

items.hinglish: Beshak hamare zimme yaqeenan hidayat dena hai
Beshak mere liye uske paas yaqeenan behtareen jaza hai
Yaqeenan aakhirat darjon mein bahut badi hai
Aur beshak woh yaqeenan tumhare Rabb ki taraf se haq hai
Aur yaqeenan aakhirat tumhare liye pehli (dunya) se behtar hai
Aur beshak hamare hi ikhtiyaar mein hai aakhirat aur dunya

data.instruction: Darj zail jumloon ka tarjuma karein:

items.hinglish: Aur Allah sabse zyada jaanne wala hai
Aur aakhirat sabse behtar aur hamesha baaqi rehne wali hai
Aur Allah sabse behtar aur hamesha baaqi rehne wala hai
Aur yaqeenan aakhirat sabse behtar hai
